items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1961-06-21
items.q: My mother's name was Rose... Her name, her maiden name was. Her first name was Carolyn.

ctx.x: I don't think we got your father's name, your mother's, and these sisters.

My father's name was Robert Carew. He ran a shoe store there, a small shoe store there in the neighborhood where we lived in Grand Rapids. My mother's name was Rose, now, I'm getting twisted now, Carolyn, Carolyn, Carolyn Rose, uh, Rosely, Carolyn Rosely Johnson. Her name, her maiden name was. Her first name was Carolyn. And, uh, I had four sisters. And, uh, three of them played the piano a little bit. Two of them quite a bit, one just a little, and the third, the fourth, the fourth sister didn't play at all. But…
there at home. You looked at music as a, from a utilitarian standpoint. You looked at it to enjoy it.
